## Description

Run a momentum long-short portfolio only when a market-state or trend filter is satisfied.

## Where it may fit

Regimes where momentum works conditionally and broad-market state offers incremental information.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short, sector ETFs, global tactical portfolios.

## Required data

Cross-sectional returns, market-index returns, state-filter signals, point-in-time universe and costs.

## Caveats
